tei:div.tei:p: "$ (125)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed rim gyi lha khrid rnam bshad zab mo rnam 'byed kyi snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/// /

(126)༄༅// bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de'i lha khrid zin bris gsum gyi dgongs pa bzhin bshad par bya'o// de la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug te lo pas rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde man ngag mtha' dag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rdo rje 'chang dngos la gsan te rje nā ro pa la gdams shing des kyang dpal lhan cig skyes ma dang dngos su mjal nas lhan cig skyes ma dang rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med kyi man ngag gsan nas sgrub thabs kyi gzhung mdzad de sras kyi thu bo rje mar pa la gnang nas da ste zhag bdun na dgun gyi nyi ma ldog /de nas nag po'i tshes bcu la dur khrod so sa'i gling du song na lhan cig skyes mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro gsungs te der byon pas lhan cig skyes ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam par bstan pa dang mjal/ bskyed rdzogs dang byin rlabs gnang*/ shel gyi gri gug gis thugs ka kha phye nas sngags 'khor bstan/ khyod rdo rje gdan sku ston pa'i tshems mche ba ltos la bod du song skal ldan rjes su zung zhig par lung bstan/ tshems (127)mche ba gzigs pas ta la'i lo ma la li khris siṅgha la'i yi ger bris pa'i dpe byang bu zhig rnyed ste spyan drangs pas bskyed rdzogs de nyid kyi dper snang*/ des rje mi la mthu chen la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi gtso bo rnams dngos su gnang*/ gnad kha cig shog dril la tham gyis mnan te/ khyod la ma 'ongs pa na rtsa rlung gi gegs shig 'byung bas de'i tshe ltos gsungs nas/ 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi kha bsgyur la// 'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam yod// ces lung bstan te gnang*/ rje mi las de la brten te grub pa brnyes nas/ rje sgam po pa la bskyed rim dngos su gnang nas rdzogs rim ni nga la yang sgom skye dka' bar byung yang 'di la brten nas skyes/

khyod la yang rtog pa 'phel 'grib cig 'byung de'i tshe 'di dgos gsung nas skyel thung gi sar gnang*/ rje sgam po pas bka' gdams kyi tshogs su bzhugs pas nyams myong 'gribs pa'i tshe 'di nyams su bzhes pas chos sku dngos su gzigs te rtogs pa'i mthar thug /des rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la kaṃ po gangs rar song zhig (128)pa'i 'gro chos su bskyed rdzogs gnyis gnang*/ de nas 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ras chen nas dpal mkha' spyod pa'i bar du skal ldan re re tsam las mi spel ba'i gsang chos su bzhugs la/ dpal mkha' spyod zhabs kyis bla ma dang mkha' 'gro las rgya cher spel zhig pa'i gnang ba thob nas gdul bya rim 'jug dgos pa rnams dkri ba'i phyir rje dus mkhyen gyi bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor rnams las waṃ skyed ma la phyi sgrub tu mdzad/ gzhung zhal gdams 'di nyid nang sgrub tu mdzad/ gsang sgrub zhal gnyis mar mdzad de slob ma rnams rig spyod nus nges su smin par mdzad de de phyin lha khrid kyi mtshan du nyi zla ltar grags shing*/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang chos kyi ming can dang lha gzigs pas zin bris su mdzad pa ste/ zin bris gsum gtso bor grags cing gzhan yang zin bris du ma byung bar snang ngo*// de yang gang bsgrub na sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa dang gso ba dang bzhed don sgrub pa dang bsten pa'i yum rdo rje'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma phyag rgya chen mo mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje btsun mo dang sna tshogs yum dang rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i mtshan mtha' yas pas bod pa de bsgrub par bya'o// de la dbye na rje don ldan zhabs kyis/ brda don rtags kyi phag mo zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum las don gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni chos nyid kyi sku mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes dngos te skye med rlung sems gnyis med kyis bsgrub la/

brda'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni// lus la ye shes chen por gnas// ces sam/ lte ba'i dbus gnas 'byung bzhi 'phro/ zhes pa ltar rdo rje'i lus la dam tshig pa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i tsaṇḍa lī ste gtso bor bde chen rlung sems gnyis med kyis bsgrub pa// rtags kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni brda don (129)gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa chos sku rtags kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i yum du snang ba dang*/ longs sku rtags kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni yul nyer bzhi'am zhe brgyad la sogs par rgyu ba gtso mo rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o// sprul sku rtags kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni sa 'og sa steng sa bla khyab par rigs so bdun sogs kyi sku'i 'gyur ba mtha' yas pas rol pa'i gtso mo rigs ldan ma'i tshul du bzhugs pa ste/ 'di rnams ni gtso bor bskyed rim gyis sgrub cing shugs kyis bskyed rdzogs re res kyang thams cad dbyer med du bsgrub bo// sgrub pa dngos la gdul bya rim 'jug gi dbang du byas nas gsum ste/ phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub bo// dang po ni/ dbang dang byin rlabs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs sems dang tshad med pa bzhi dang yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas kyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bla dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa la phyag dang mchod pa sogs yan lag bdun pa byas la tshogs gsag tshogs zhing gshegs pa'am rang la bsdus te swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma ro gdan nyi ma'i steng du sems nyid waṃ dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gcer bu rus rgyan can gri thod dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa gar stabs kyis bzhengs pa/

thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can khro mo spyan gsum pa dbu skra gyen du brdzes cing me phung gi nang na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs kar pad nyi la waṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba bsam/ de'i 'od kyis ye (130)shes pa spyan drangs te rang la bstim/ yang 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis sku gang*/ chu rgyun spyi bor 'khyil bas rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par bsam mo// 'di la ye shes pa dang dbang lha lhan cig pa nang sgrub ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas lha sku gsal la rtog pa med pa ci nus su bsgom/ skyon sa bon las 'od zer dmar po 'phros lus gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /'od phyir 'phros snod chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang dang bcud yi dam gyi skur gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad yi dam gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ sa bon la bstim zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī yai badzra warṇ+ṇa nī yai badzra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes oṃ gsum ma dang ha ri ni sa spangs pa'i snying po ci nus bzla'o// mthar sa bon las 'phros pa'i lha mos mchod par bsam ste mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ gtor mgron spyan drangs te gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ bzod gsol byas nas snod bcud bdag nyid dang*/ de sa bon/ de nā da dang*/ de yang mi dmigs par bzhag /de nas sgyu ma'i skur langs te rjes thob lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi sogs su bcad de 'bum phrag bzhir bzla ba ni phyi sgrub ste bsnyen pa'i dod waṃ bskyed ma'i nyams len yin no// gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos ni skabs 'dir nang sgrub ces bya la/ de yang dpal nā ro'i gzhung las/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni// yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar// gsol ba gang btab 'thob 'gyur ba// de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya// zhes pas dgos pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i rtsom par dam bca' ba bstan to// 'di nyams su blang ba la bzhi/

ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul/ grub nas spyod pa bya tshul/ bsrung bya'i dam tshig /'thob bya'i 'bras bu'o// dang po la (131)gsum/ bskyed rim gyis sgrub pa/ rdzogs rim gyis sgrub pa/ yan lag gi don to// dang po bskyed rim la bzhi/ gang du sgrub pa'i gnas/ nam sgrub pa'i dus/ sgrub pa'i bkod pa bshams/ sgrub pa dngos so// dang po ni/ ri bo'i rtse dang dur khrod dang*// shing gcig drung dang phug stong dang*// bas mtha' dben pa'i gnas dag tu// zhes pas gnas de dag dang*/ rje mar pa'i zhal gdams las/ brag dmar po kha nub tu lta ba bya thal gyis ma gos pa grub thob gong mas zhabs kyi bcag pa'i gnas ces gsungs pas khyad par gyi gnas de lta bur sgrub ste 'dis ni sa brtag pa'i don yang tshang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ yar gyi ngo yi tshes bcu la// zhes pas dgu yan la bca' ga tshogs par byas te bcu nas sgrub/ gsum pa ni/ bsang chu'i don du thog mar lag mchod bya ste/ skyes pa'i thod pa cha gcig pa'am cha gsum par 'bras sogs 'bru dang*/ rgun 'bru sogs shing thog dang*/ bu ram sogs shing dang*/ sbrang rtsi sogs me tog las byung ba'i myos byed de chang sna bzhi gang rung la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba bzhag /rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i srin lag g.yon gyis bdud rtsi blangs te bi gahṇāṃ bzla bzhin 'thor bas bgegs bsang*/ lag pa so so'i sor ma lnga mthe bong sa nas mthe'u chung nam mkha'i bar 'byung ba lngar lhun grub tu gnas pa'i g.yon gyi theb srin sa rlung thabs shes su sbyar ba chos 'byung lhun grub tu 'byung ba steng du blta bas bcas te 'og tu sbub nas swa bhā wa brjod bzhin pas chang gi nang du mdun nas g.yon ngos su zlum por bskor bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dkar mer bsam pa ni bde ba'i brda'o// de nas mdun nas g.yon skor du chos 'byung gru gsum pa bri bzhin pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pa ni bde ba stong par rtogs pa'i brda'o// de'i dbus su hrīḥha ri (132)ni sa zhes thig le lnga byas pa ni stong pa rang rig 'od gsal du rtogs pa'i brda ste gsum mo// de nas chang nang du lha lnga brten pa bskyed pa ni chang gi dkyil 'khor ro// de bzhin du lag pa phan tshun bsang ste g.yas kyi mtheb srin sbyar pas bdud rtsi blangs te lag mthil g.yon par brda gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bris te bskyed pa ni lag pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// de gnyis la thun mong du mchod yon dang nyer spyod lnga rol mor bcas pas mchod pa phyi mchod/

sha lnga bdud bdud rtsi lngas mchod pa nang*/ bde stong gis mchod pa gsang ba ste mchod pa gsum bya/ bstod nas g.yas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya phyed pa dpral bar bzhag ste rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos te pheṃ yig brjod/ mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad bod skad mas bstod/ 'di la rgyas par na yab kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed/ mngon byang lnga las gtso bo yab yum dang sa bon las 'khor bskyed de lha lnga'am bcu gsum mam drug cu rtsa gnyis pa lta bu gang mos bskyed/ go cha bkod/ ye shes pa gzhug /dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod bzlas pa byed de mdor na rgyas bsdus gang yin yang 'di ni nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor te dkyil 'khor gsum zhes bya ste brda gsum dkyil 'khor gsum mchod pa gsum ste lag mchod kyi don dgur yi ge rnying pa rnams las bshad do// de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lag pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstim pas yab yum rten brten par bcas pa dbyer med du zhu/ de chang la blugs pas chang gi dkyil 'khor yang zhu ste dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin sku'i bdud rtsi'i zla ba ltar dkar/ gsung gi bdud rtsi nyi ltar dmar/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi bai ḍūrya'i (133)mdog ltar sngo bar mos te rim pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod bzhin pa chos 'byung skye gnas kyi rgya g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ kha dog dri ro nus pa sbyong ba'i phyir sdom 'byung las bshad pa'i ha hoḥhrīḥyang brjod na rung ngo*// lag mchod kyi bya ba 'di ni sdom 'byung las// zhi ba'i btung ba lha mo ste// rdo rje rnam snang mdzad gzugs gnas// rnam snang mdzad ma'i sku dbus su// he ru ka ni zhu bar gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ste lag mchod gzhan las khyad par du 'phags la/

'dis bgegs bsang ba dang rdzas sbyang ba thams cad byed de/ sdom 'byung las/ bdud rtsi drag po'i gzugs can ma// 'phrog dang bya ba longs spyod la// de phyir snying po bdud rtsi yin// zhes so// phan yon ni/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ lag pa'i mchod pas rnal 'byor pa// dbul ba'i 'dod don 'grub par 'gyur// sems ni gzhan du gyur pa dang*// bza' btung gos sogs 'thob par 'gyur// lha yi mchod pa byas na ni// de la bsam pa rnam 'grub 'gyur// zhes bshad do// de nas sa bslang ba'i don du gtor ma nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ lag mchod dang bi ghnāṃ gyis bsang sbyangs te gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlab/ phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud sogs ma rgyud mang por/ mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar// mthe bo rdo rje brtan por sbyar byas te// de ni dpral ba'i dbus su rab sbyar nas// bskor zhing bskor zhing kun tu bskor bar bya// rkang pa mnan zhing gyen du blta// gyen du pheṃ gyi sgra sgrogs pas// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs// ces pa ltar tsog pu rkang pa g.yas kyi brang bas g.yon gyi bo la gong mnan/ lag pa gnyis mdzub mo lcags sgrog ltar (134)mdud cing mthe bong gnyis dang gung mo gnyis so sor rtse sprad/ lhag ma me ri ltar brgyangs pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'am dra ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon du bskor zhing mig gyen du blta bas pheṃ yig gsum mam bdun brjod pas 'das ma 'das kyi gtor mgron thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs par mos te badzra a ra li sogs kyi sngags brjod/ mchod nas gtor sngags kyis dbul gtor ma gtsang sar dor te gzhi bdag la brda bkrol zhing dkar phyogs la grogs gzhol bar bya'o// de nas sa srung ba dang bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir rang nyid kyi sku las khro mo'i tshogs dpag med spros te nag po'i phyogs rnams la bka' bsgos te bskrad/

mi 'gro ba rnams me 'od kyis bsregs te slar thugs ka nas rdo rje'i tshogs dpag med spros pa 'og tu sprin 'khrigs pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de bzhin du ra ba drwa ba gur bla res phyi me phung dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor ngo bo ye shes kyi rang bzhin rnam pa sra zhing brtan pa bsam ste oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ de nas lte ba'i hrīḥlas seng gdong ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dpag med steng phyogs su spro zhing mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor bzhin pas oṃ siṅga mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ de bzhin du khwa gdong ma nag mo shar du oṃ kā ka syai mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'ug gdong ma ljang gu byang du oṃ ū lu ka sye mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khyi gdong ma dmar mo nub tu oṃ shwa na ka syai mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phag gdong ma ser mo lhor/ oṃ sū ra ka syai mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stag gdong ma nag mo 'og tu oṃ byā ghṛ syai mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje brtan ma dang pho nya ma dang mche ba ma dang 'joms ma rnams phyed gzugs can dpag med me nas g.yas skor du mtshams so sor spro zhing bai ro tsa nā'am yang na oṃ ya ma dṛ ḍha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ya ma dū (135)twi/ ya ma daṃṣṭi ni/ ya ma ma tha nī/ zhes brjod/ yang na sgo mtshams thams cad bai ro tsa nī khongs spros kyang rung ngo*// lha mo de re re yang dpag tu med pas srung 'khor gyi phyi nang go mtshams med par khyab pa la/ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can/ sogs kyis bka' bsgo/ thams cad kyang nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrugs pas srung zlog gi las mdzad bgegs thams cad phur bus btab par bsam zhing bhā ta ya'i sngags brjod do// srung 'khor rgyas par spro na lte ba'i sa bon las spros pa'i hrīḥlas gri gug gir gur bla re/ ha las rdo rje/ ri las rin chen/ ni las padma/

sa las ral gri ste phyag mtshan lnga dang*/ lam las sa'i rang bzhin 'khor lo ser po/ waṃ las chu/ raṃ las me/ yaṃ las rlung gi rang bzhin mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i sa gzhir gur bla re sogs bsam zhing sngar ltar sgo mtshams ma spro ste srung 'khor dgu rim zhes bya'o// de nas sa byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ mdzes pa'i maṇḍal chag chag gdab/ dri dang chang gis byug par bya/ zhes pas mi rta khyi gsum gyi khrag dang dri bzang po dang rang byung gi mtshal dang lag mchod kyi rdzas bsres pas sa phyogs thams cad la chag chag bya zhing ye shes kyi rang bzhin du bsam/ dbus su stegs bu maṇḍal dbus mtho zhing shar dang byang du gzhol ba 'jam zhing brtan pa ji ltar 'tsham pa byas te ba byung lnga dang rdzas de dag gis ko ba tsam du byug /dkyil 'khor bri tshul ni/ chos 'byung padmar ldan pa bri// rang rang phyag mtshan steng du dgod// me tog dmar po'i tshom bu'ang dgram// zhes pas rdul tshon dang*/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā la// btung ba bzang pos legs par bkang*// bdud rtsi lnga dang rtsa brgyad stong*// rin chen 'bru dang snying po lnga// gang (136)'dod rdzas rnams gzhug par bya// zhes pas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// ma nyams me long gtsang ma la// shes rab mtshal dang zhes pas mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi dkyil 'khor/ sindhu ras/ chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol mar bri// zhes pa dang*/ leb rgan dmar po'i steng du bzhag /zhes pas sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gsungs te/ dang por rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la lha sta gon gyi dod du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ stegs bu'i steng gi nam mkha' bsangs te g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs pas rang gi smin mtshams nas rna ba g.yas pa'i phyogs su bskor bas sba bhā wa brjod bzhin du zlum bskor bya/ yi ge gsum brjod bzhin pas rna ba g.yon nas g.yas kyi bar dang de nas nub dang slar rna ba g.yon du 'then te gdan thabs kyi chos 'byung bsam/

smin mtshams nas rlung dang de nas bden bral de shar smin mtshams su then te khang thabs kyi chos 'byung bri/ snying po brjod bzhin pas dbus su thig le dmar po bya/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās shar du thig le sngon po/ de bzhin du ratna ḍā ki/ padma ḍā ki/ karma ḍā ki zhes phyogs so sor rang mdog gi thig le bya/ de rnams kyi 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas te slar bdud rtsi'i thigs pa so sor reg bzhin pas hrīḥha ri ni sa brjod ste yi ge lnga gyur par bsam/ de las lha lngar bskyed/ sa bon bkod de mdun bskyed ltar spyan 'dren mchod bstod dbang bskur ye shes pa bstim pa dang bzlas pa cung zad byas te mchod cing bstod nas dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i gnang ba stsol bar gsol ba gdab/ phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bris la rang bzhin gyi don gyis shig par gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas srad bu chal du bcal bas sa gzhi la thig bya ste/ tshangs zur bzhi bo legs (137)par btab/ ji tsam 'tsham par zlum por bskor// dbus nas zlum po'i bar tshad de// shar gyi zlum mtshams phrad par bzung*// lho byang gnyis su mtshan ma bya// de steng gdan thabs chos 'byung gdab// nub kyi zlum tshangs phrad pa nas// sngar ltar gzhal ste khang thabs gdab// cha phran phra mo re re'i tshad// gnyis ka'i nang nas slar yang gdab// dbus nas ngos chen la reg par// zlum skor slar yang de yi nang*// sum cha phyed gnyis dor bar bskor// slar yang zlum skor gnyis ka'i nang*// cha shas phra ba re re bskor// nang nas rim bzhin ze'u 'bru dang*// ge sar 'dab ma mu khyud yin// pho brang khyams kyi zlum po'i phyir// cha bran gnyis dang gcig dang bzhis// nang nas rim bzhin bskor ba yis// thod phreng rdo ra me ri'o// zhes pa ltar btab ste tshon kha dog sna lnga ye shes lnga dang mkha' 'gro lngar mos pas snying po brjod bzhin pas thog mar khang thabs kyi chos 'byung gi re khā g.yon skor du bri zhing de nas gzhan rnams kyang rim pas bri zhing dgram mo/

kha dog yang chos 'byung gi re khā dkar nang dmar padma'i lte ba dmar ge sar dmar ser 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog gong ras mdzes tshon mu khyud dang khyams ljang gu phyi rol gzhi nag po la thod phreng g.yon du lta ba dkar po/ rdo rje ser po bzhi phyogs tshon me ri mdog sna tshogs g.yon du 'khyil pa zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa bzhi ser po/ padma'i lte bar nyi ma la gri gug so sngon po yu ba rdo rje phyed pa ser po/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rdo rje sngon po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu padma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang gu ste phyag mtshan lnga bri/ phyag mtshan so so'i lte bar me tog dmar po'i tshom bu dgod/ chos 'byung gi khugs drug tu dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon du 'khor ba re bri'o// (138)de nas dkyil 'khor de rten brten pa dang bcas par gsal btab ste nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor phab nas dbyer med du bstim mo// de nas gzhung du ma gsungs kyang zhal gdams kyi bcu gnyis par gsungs pa ltar bum pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ bum pa gtsang ma la gu gul gyis bdug ste/ se ba'i me tog utpal sngo// kaṇḍa ka ri shu dag dkar// tseg mgo sna na sman lnga'o// nas gro til dkar 'bras so ba// mon sran bcas pa 'bru lnga'o// gser dngul ind+ra nī la dang*// pad rag mu tig mchog lnga ste// yang na/ gser dngul zangs lcags gsha' tsho ste// lcags rigs kho na'i rin chen lnga'o// ga bur li shi dzā ti dang*// gur gum tsandan dri lnga'o// sbrang rtsi bu ram lan tshwa mar// a ru ra ste snying po lnga'o// de ltar rdzas nyer lnga bo khrol bur blug go /bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar chu gtsang gis bkang*// mgul chings srog lnga pas bcing*// shing los kha brgyan te dkyil 'khor dbus su khri'u'i steng du bzhag go /de nas rim bzhin thod pa mtshan ldan dang*/ dar dmar dang*/ li'i me long bug pa med pa 'brug lo 'brug zla 'brug nyi la 'gar ba 'brug lo pas nyin gcig gis tshar bar byas te bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas sha drod la zhag 'ga' bcangs pa zhig 'byor na legs/

ma 'byor na yang me long gtsang ma'i dang por nang dang de nas phyi rnams so sor lag mchod kyis bgegs bsang*/ pang du bzhag ste rang rang gi tshad tsam du steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bri zhing bskyed de gnang ba gsol/ sihla dang gur gum dang bdud rtsi sogs sbyar bas thod pa'i nang*/ dar dmar gyi ngos/ me long gi nang ngos rnams la zlum skor chos 'byung padma sa bon lnga dga' 'khyil drug dang bcas pa dang*/ me long gi phyi ngos la lag mchod kyi rdzas byugs/ rgya gar (139)gyi'am ma 'byor na bod kyi yang rung ste/ sindhū ra bdal ba'am dar chags kyis btab ste zlum skor sogs sngar 'dra ba las hrīḥ'i mthar oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa/ ri ni sa ha/ ni ri ha sa/ sa ni ri ha/ ā karṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes g.yon skor du 'bri/ so so'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bstim ste bum pa'i kha rgyan gyi gseb bam khri'u che ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu dang bcas pa'i ma da na'am/ sman du bsgrub na bshal sman dang dug rigs ma gtogs rtsa brgyad stong gi sman gang 'byor bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs dang sbyar ba'i phye ma'am ril bus bkang ste bzhag /dar dmar gyis dgab/ steng du me long bzhag ste/ de ltar rdul tshon/ bum pa/ thod pa/ dar dmar/ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud/ sindhū ra ste dkyil 'khor drug po mdun nub nas shar du phyogs par brtsegs/ steng nas dar dmar gyi gur phub/ mtha' mchod pa dang sha sna tshogs kyi gtor mas bskor ro// 'di la dar dmar la dkyil 'khor mi byed pa yang yod cing*/ spyir sgrub pa'i dus drug brtsegs/ dbang bskur gyi dus mkha' 'gro dbang sdud ma gtogs pa'i lnga brtsegs/ dus bzang gi mchod pa sogs la/ rdul tshon thod pa sindhū ra ste sum brtsegs kyis kyang chog go /de ltar bkod pa tshar nas sdod tshul ni// bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni// o rgyan phyogs su kha bltas la// zhes pas rnal 'byor pa stan ci bde ba la kha dkyil 'khor du phyogs pas 'khod/

lag mchod rdo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru rnams g.yon nas rim gyis mdun du dgod do// bzhi pa sgrub pa dngos la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i cho ga'o// dang po la mnyam bzhag gi bya ba dang rjes thob kyi bya ba gnyis/ dang po la yang sngon (140)'gro tshogs gsog /dngos gzhi sgom bzlas gnyis las dang po ni/ byang chub sems bskyed sngon 'gro bas// dkyil 'khor cho gas mnyes par bya// yi ge gsum gyis rang la bsdu// zhes pas thog mar bdud rtsi ril bu'am lag mchod kyi thigs pa lce thog tu bzhag pas bdud rtsi myang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ srung 'khor bsgom/ mtshams bcad/ mchod pa byin brlab/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa sangs rgyas/ de'i snying po la sogs pa chos/ 'khor mkha' 'gro rnams dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ sems bskyed bsgom mo// de nas spyi bor pad zla hūm̐ las rdor sems he ru ka sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing g.yon dril bu bsnyems pas kur brten pa/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum dang khyad par yab kyi thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya ba dkar pos bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa bstim/ yang 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas stobs bzhi dang ldan pas thugs ka'i sa bon gyi sngags phreng la dmigs te yig brgya bzlas pas yig brgya las bdud rtsi bab/

rdor sems kyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams nas lud de rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa dag nas lus 'od gsal (141) bar bsam zhing mthar rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la bstim mo// 'di ltar yig brgya 'bum bzlas pas rtsa ltung 'dag cing nyer gcig re thun re la bzlas pas ni sngags kyi ltung ba byin brlab bo// spro na phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes padma gar dbang*/ 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbyer med pa dpal lhan cig skyes ma'o// mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ kha 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ mkha' khams padma can gyi bdag nyid tu byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo'i sa bon las 'od zer spros te ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la yan lag bdun pas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag /maṇḍal bya/ gsol ba btab ste lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid 'od zer kha dog lnga byung ste bdag nyid kyi dpral mgrin snying lte gsang ba ste lngar thim pas dug lnga dag /ye shes lnga mngon du byas te mkha' 'gro lnga'i go 'phang thob par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ sems can thams cad la dmigs te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo// dngos gzhi la sgom bzlas gnyis las/ dang po rten brten pa bsgom pa ni/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun// skad cig tsam gyis rdzogs par bsgom// stong pa'i ngang (142)yi ge hrīḥ

/bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// khro mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// dzā wa sindhū ra dang mtshungs// sku yi 'od zer stong gsum khyab// dbu skra thor tshugs tshangs par 'khyil// sangs rgyas lnga mtshon thod pas brgyan// rdo rje thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ bcas// dar dbyangs cod pan rnam par 'phur// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// me tog phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spras// padma ro dang nyi ma'i gdan// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs// chu las nya ldang ji bzhin du// skad cig tsam gyis rdzogs par bskyed// ces pas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi phyogs mtshams brgyad du phye ba/ shing*/ me/ chu/ sprin/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs dur khrod kyi mtshan nyid tshang bar bsgom pa ni gang zag tha mal mi rtag pa dang 'bring la bdag med dang rab la 'khor 'das ro mnyam du ston pa'o// de'i dbus su 'khor ba dag pa'i gdan thabs kyi chos 'byung bting ba'i steng du myang 'das dag pa'i khang thabs kyi chos 'byung gzhal yas khang dngos ni srid par mi gnas cing srid pa mi 'dor bas rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba chos kyi dbyings kyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar skyes pa'i ro ser po tsho zhing snub pa dbang po'i sgo nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa drod ma yal ba zhig mgo g.yon du bstan te gan rkyal du 'gyel pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar zhing zlum pa'i steng du rang sems 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po btags stan la zug pa gu gu nam mkha' la lding ba tsheg drag gnyis kyis brten pa (143)de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog pas de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/

de rnams dang bcas te 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu las nya ldangs pa ltar skad cig gis rang nyid rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur te de yang chos thams cad kyi sku ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ zhes pa nas/ brkyang bskum gyis gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar zhal gdams ltar rnam dag dran pas bsgom mo// de nas lus gnad bcas te stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams chos drug ltar bsgom/ 'khor bskyed pa ni/ de yi 'khor lo rnam bzhi la// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'khor bcas bskyed// ces pas lha yas nas mar gsal gdab pa ni dbu ma'i yar sna'i rang bzhin spyi bor thor tshugs kyi nang rdo rje phyed pa'i lte ba sbubs stong gi nang du bla ma rnam snang 'khor los sgyur ba'am rnam snang he ru ka'i rnam pas pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ de'i 'khor dang phyi rol gyi dus pa'i 'khor lo'i steng du yang brgyud pa'i bla ma dang grub thob kyi tshogs sprin ltar du gtibs pa/ 'khor lo'i dbus so sor pad nyi re re gnas pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi pad nyi la ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo rdo rje'i gri thod can/ rtsa sgo so gnyis su 'khor rang 'dra re re/ de bzhin du lte bar sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang mo ral gri'i gri thod can/ 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba'i bar gzhung ltar bsgom/ de nas gtso mo'i nang gi gsang gnas te rtsa gsum 'dus mdor ye shes kyi me'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung bsnol ma gdan thabs kyi dbus su padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam mo// de nas sa bon gyi yi ge mas nas dgod ste/ nyi ma'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po de'i mthar oṃ (144)badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dmar po me lta bu oṃ nas g.yas su bkod de bskor ba/

'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa/ khugs drug tu dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon du 'khyil ba re bsam/ 'khor bzhi'i gtso mo'i thugs kar padma dang mdog gi lte ba can 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re bsgom/ de las lte ba'i las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar dbus su sa yig ljang gu/ 'dab ma bzhi la mdun nas g.yas bskor du hrīḥha ri ni/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar sa rkyang pa re/ snying ga'i padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ni dmar po/ 'dab bzhi la hīḥha ris/ 'khor la ni rkyang*/ mgrin par rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ri ser po/ 'dab ma bzhir hrīḥha ni sa/ 'khor la ri yig /spyi bo'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro la dbus su ha sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la hrīḥri ni sa/ 'khor la ha yig re bsam mo// de ltar lha bskyed yi ge bkod nas ye shes pa gzhug pa dang dbang bskur ba'i phyir rang bzhin gnas pa'i pho brang nas/ spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim/ zhes pas sa bon gyi yi ge thams cad dang khyad par don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la spro na mchod pa gsum 'bul/ ye shes pa'i sku las sku'i tshogs byon/ dam tshig pa la thim su dbyer med du byas pas bum dbang ngo*// ye shes pa'i mgrin pa nas āḥli dkar po dang kā li dmar po'i tshogs byon mgrin par thim/ gsung dbyer med du byas pas gsang dbang ngo*// thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung dam tshig pa'i thugs kar zhugs bde stong gi ye shes skyes te thugs dbyer med du byas pa dbang (145)gsum pa'o// de nas ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la dbyer med du gyur pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ de yang rang rang thugs kar ni// gsang sngags yi ge bkod bzlas bya// zhes pa ste 'di la sgo gsum gyi bzlas pa gsum las/

dang po lus kyi bzlas pa ni/ bodhi tsi'am tsandan dmar po la sogs pa'i phreng ba phreng thag zung ma yin pa mdud 'dzin gnyis brtsegs can lag mthil g.yon padma 'dab ma gsum par bsams pa'i dbus su sbrul bskyil ba ltar bzhag /g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga par mos pas steng nas bkab ste phreng thag snying po'i sngags phreng*/ phreng rdog rnams sa bon so so'i ā li kā li'i tshogs las 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang mdud 'dzin 'og ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa gzugs sku'i rang bzhin dang steng ma yang 'khor lo sdom pa chos sku'i bdag nyid de kha sbyor gyi sku sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bor mos te ye shes pa dpag med bstim/ mchod cing bstod nas zhu ba las rnam pa 'du byed dag pa'i thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ngo bo sngags kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid tu mos te mthe bong g.yon pa rdo rje lcags kyu'i rnam pas phreng rdog re re zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i ngo bor spyan drangs te lte ba'i hrīḥyig la thim pas lha dbang du gyur par bsam ste sor mo bzhi sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i steng du bgrang bar bya'o// ngag gi bzlas pa ni sngags dag cing gsal bas/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po bzla zhing brtan pa thob nas gzhung nas gsungs pa'i las sbyor gyi sngags oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa ni ri sa ha ni ri ha sa sa ni ri ha ā karṣa ya hrīḥdza zhes bzla'o// sgo gsum thun mong du mi sdod pa rnam gsum gyi bzlas pa ni/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then te steng rlung glod ste lus mi (146)sdod pa g.yo 'gul dang bcas nas bzla ba ni phyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sku'i srog dbang du bsdu ba'o// ming tshig gi bar ma chod par bzla ba ni nang mkha' 'gro ma'i gsung gi srog dbang du bsdu ba'o// dang po dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu sdud cing mthar rnam par rtog pa gcig gis kyang bar ma chod par bzla ba ni gsang ba mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kyi srog dbang du bsdu ba'o// sems kyi bzlas pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las thun mong gi bzlas pa ni/

don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi hrīḥlas 'od dmar po spros te snod bcud sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas rang dang sa bon la bstim zhing lus ngag yid gsum dang mi sdod rnam gsum gyis bzla'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlas pa la lnga ste/ sku gsal gdab kyi bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas chung ngu*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas chen po'o// dang po ni/ dang po don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi hrīḥyig la rtse gcig tu dmigs te bzla/ de nas rim bzhin sngags phreng nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ ze'u 'bru/ ge sar/ sa bon bzhi/ 'dab ma bzhi/ dga' 'khyil drug /chos 'byung bsnol ma dmar la tsha ba ro rkyang gi mar sna dbu mar chud pa/ dbu ma'i mar sna rag dung gi kha ltar yangs pa/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka'i sa yig ljang gu/ nyi ma/ ze'u 'bru/ ge sar/ shar gyi hrīḥ lho'i ha/ nub kyi ri/ byang gi ni/ 'dab ma bzhi/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i spyi bo rdo rje phyed pa/ thor tshugs/ 'khor lo/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ zhal ras/ phyag gnyis/ phyag mtshan/ sku stod/ sku smad/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga/ nyi gdan/ ro (147)ser po/ padma/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa yig /'khor so so// lte ba'i rtsa 'khor 'dab ma re bzhi pa gdugs 'degs kyi padma ltar kha gyen bstan sogs rim bzhin spyi bo'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bar dang*/ gtsug tor gyi thad du bla ma rnam snang du bzhugs pa/ de'i 'khor grub thob kyi tshogs gtsug tor gyi phyi dbyibs rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa'i rnam pa/ dbu skra gnag la snum pa phyed gyen du brdzes te 'khor lo'i lte ba nas drangs te ral pa'i cod pan du byas pa/ lhag ma rgyab du sil bur grol ba/ mi rus kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa phyi mu khyad med pa/

skra mtshams su rdo rje nag po chur nyal ba'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa/ de'i steng du thod pa skam po dkar la 'tsher ba pheṃ gyi sgra sgrogs pa lnga yis dbu brgyan pa/ de'i steng du lha mi'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi rtse bran can/ thod skam gyi kha nas rus pa'i za ra tshags dra ba dang dra phyed tu 'phyang ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang dbu rgyan gyi rtse rus pa'i phreng bas sbrel ba/ dbu skra bcings pa'i dar dpyangs phan tshun du rlung gis spyod pa/ sku mdog me dang sindhūr ltar dmar zhing bskal pa'i me 'od 'phro bas brtan g.yo thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags phye dang rdul 'dres pa las btab pa ltar g.yo zhing bcud 'phrog pa/ zhal ras nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar rgyas cing dmar ba/ spyan gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes yangs pa/ smin ma dmar zhing 'khyug pa/ shangs dkyus ring zhing mdzes pa/ mkhur tshos rgyas cing khrag gis lcid pa/ zhal mchu'i sgros mdzes cing yid du 'ong ba/ tshems dkar zhing thag bzang ba bzhi bcu tshang ba/ khyad par mche ba bzhi dgar zlum rno ba/ cung zad gtsigs te yas kyi mche bas ma mchu non tsam pa/ ljags dmar zhing srab la yangs pa yas rkan la dril te hrīḥdang pheṃ gyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs (148)pa/ snyan gnyis snyan shal ring por 'phyangs shing snyan rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ mgul pa 'jam zhing mgul rgyan gyis bkra ba/ sku stod seng ge'i rgyal po ltar kho lag yangs cing brtan pa/ zlum zhing 'bur ba'i nu 'bur zung zla ba ltar rgyas pa/ padma'i sdong bu ltar 'jam zhing gzhon mnyen pa'i phyag gnyis kyi mthil dmar zhing 'jam la sor mo dra bas 'brel ba can/ phyag gdub dang dpung gdub dang sor gdub kyis mdzes pa'i phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig pa lha min gyi khrag gis bkang ste rba rlabs 'khyil ba zhal du gsol bzhin pa/ gru mo g.yon gyi nang du kha ṭwāṃ ga rtser rdo rje phyed pa dang bar du mi mgo skam rnying rlon pa brtsegs pa'i 'og tu bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje rgya gram las dar dpyangs dang dril bu dang ḍā ma ru 'phyangs pa la yu ba brgyad gzhogs sam 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi tshul gyi mar snar rdo rje phyed pa can ro'i lte ba'i khung bur zug cing sku tshad dang dpangs mnyam pa/

rked pa phra zhing ldem pa la rus pa dang rin po che'i ska rags dril bu g.yer ka 'khrol bas brgyan pa sku smad rgyas shing sgeg la bcud kyis gang ba/ brla zung chu shing ltar sra zhing zlum la 'dril ba/ byin pa ri dwags e n+ya lta bur zlum zhing byin gyis phra ba zhabs long bu mi mngon la mthil mnyam zhing dmar la rting pa yangs shing zhabs sor rnams dra bas 'brel pa dang ldan pa/ zhabs gdub kyis mdzes pa'i zhabs g.yas bskums te kha ṭwāṃ la 'khyud nas g.yon pa'i brla la zhabs sor gtad pa/ g.yon brkyangs pas ro'i snying ga'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la zhabs kyi brang ba reg tsam pas gar ling ling byed bzhin pa lta bu/ sems byung gi rtog pa'i rang bzhin mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal 'phyangs pa/ me tog kar wī ra dmar po'i phreng ba dang rus pa dang (149)rin po che'i do shal gyi tshogs du mas brgyan pa/ gdan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar zlum tsha zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i 'og gi skyes pa'i ro ser po tsho zhing snum pa gzhon zhing yid du 'ong ba phyi dbugs chad pa nang dbugs ma chad pas drod ma yal ba dbang po'i sgo nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa mgo g.yon du bstan nas gan rkyal du bsgyel pa/ gdan padma'i ze'u 'bru dmar po ge sar dmar ser/ 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog /sdong bu 'dab ma dang bcas pa/ khang thabs kyi chos 'byung zur gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar zhing nang thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar ba rgya tshad chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ 'og tu gdan thabs kyi chos 'byung padma rā ga'i sa gzhi lta bur dmar zhing 'od 'phro ba/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du shirsha la sogs shing chen po brgyad/ shing de'i rtsa bar brgya byin sogs phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi lo ma'i dbus nas lus phyed thon pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/

grub pa'i ri brgyad rtser mchod rten chen po brgyad/ logs la dngos grub kyi phug la brten pa'i grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad/ chu chen po brgyad/ de la brten pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ steng du 'brug sgrogs zhing char 'bab pa'i sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang me chen po dang sha za dang srin po dang 'byung po dang ro langs dang ro gsar rnying gi tshogs kyis khyab pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de nas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi sra zhing lhun stug la rgya rngams tshad med pa la sogs rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba 'thug zhing sra la yangs pa steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla res sra zhing dpang mtho la nang yangs pa phyi rol thams cad rdo rje'i 'od zer me lce gcig tu 'khyil ba/ sgo mtshams kyi lha mo nyi zer gyi rdul grangs lta bus srung 'khor gyi nang bar thams cad lang long du go mtshams med pas (150)srung zlog gi las la brtson pa'i bar du re re zhing gsal btab ste gsal zhing drag la yun ring bar bsgom zhing bzla ba ni nang nas phyir gsal gdab pa'o// yang sgo mtshams kyi lha mo nas lte ba'i hrīḥ'i bar sngar lta bu las tshur rim gyis gsal gdab cing bzla ba ni phyi nas nang du gsal gdab pa'o// las dang po pa sku spyi la dmigs mi nus pa yin na dang por nang gi yi ge rnams kho na la 'og nas steng dang steng nas 'og tu gsal btab cing bzla ba la yi ge gsal gdab ces bya zhing phyis goms nas sngar bstan pa ltar sgom pa la sku gsal gdab ces bya'o// 'di rnams kyis dmigs pa gsal zhing las su rung la rnam rtog gi gnyen por 'gyur ro// gnyis pa 'gog bzlas chung ngu ni/ des dmigs pa gar gtad du zin pa'i tshe/ don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo'i hrīḥl sems rtse gcig tu glod ste bzla zhing de bzhin du don sgrub 'khor lo tshad ma dang*/ 'khor lo so so'i lha 'khor bcas dang*/ spyi bo'i bla ma dang*/

sku yongs rdzogs dang*/ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor tshang ma'i bar gyi gong gsal re rer rtse gcig tu bzhag ste bzla zhing skabs su dmigs pa spo la bying rgod sogs byung na sku gsal gdab kyi bzlas pa byas pas sel lo// 'dis ni rlung dang rtog pa 'gog nus pa'i phyir 'gog bzlas yin la rtog pa'i sgom pa dang cung zad 'dres pas na 'gog bzlas chung ngu'o// 'di gnyis kyis yul/ yul can gyi g.yo ba 'ching zhing bsam gtan gyi yan lag grub pas sor bsam dang chos mtshungs so// gsum pa spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ de nas rlung dang rtog pa dbyer med pa 'ching ba'i phyir dang por 'khor lo'i dbus kyi sngags phreng hrīḥl bskor ba'i tshul du g.yon du gu lu lu 'gro bar bsam/ de nas rim gyis je dmar je tsha je mgyogs su song ste me 'bar la khad par g.yon du drag tu 'khor zhing sngags de rnams las du ba'i (151)tshul du 'od dkar po spos reng las dud pa thon pa ltar skya thol thol byung*// sngags phreng gi steng gi nam mkhar 'od de rnams phan tshun 'brel pas dngul gyi a long srub med pa lta bu'i 'od kor du gyur te sngags phreng dang 'od kor gnyis ga g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzla ba ni spro bsdu'i gzhi 'dzin pa'o// spro bsdu dngos la rtsa g.yon lam sbyang ba dang*/ g.yas lam sbyang ba/ dbu ma nas drang ba ste gsum/ re re la yang steng spro steng sdud/ steng spro 'og sdud/ 'og spro steng sdud/ 'og spro 'og sdud ste bzhi bzhi yod pas dmigs pa bcu gnyis/ de re re la 'od dmar po dang*/ dkar dmar dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngags phreng ste bzhir 'gyur bas dmigs pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad du 'gyur ro// de yang 'od dkar po de'i g.yon ngos nas g.yon rkyang ma'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo 'od skud dkar po dngul gyi skud pa lta bu nar gyis byung thur du lhung rkyang ma'i mar sna nas zhugs gyen du song spyi bo'i thad nas thur du byung ste sna bug g.yon nas thon te smin mtshams kyi nam mkhar sor bcu drug gi sar dga' 'khyil dkar po yol thabs su g.yon du 'khor bar gyur/

de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi lus dag par byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs 'od dkar por bsdus/ dga' 'khyil la thim pas 'od skud du gyur te sna bug g.yon nas zhugs rkyang ma brgyud de 'od kor ram gzhi'i sngags phreng hrīḥbacas la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing bzla ba ni steng spro steng sdud do// gzhan de lta bu dang 'dra ba la dga' 'khyil 'od skud du gyur pa'i tshe 'od skud thur du song gsang ba'i sgo nas zhugs sngags phreng dang hrīḥl thim pa ni steng spro 'og sdud to// yang nang gi 'od kor gyi g.yon ngos nas 'od skud thur du lhung dbu ma'i mar sna nas thon gsang gnas kyi sgo nas phyir byung zhabs (152)g.yas kyi rting pa'i thad sor bcu drug gi nam mkhar dga' 'khyil dkar po gdan thabs g.yon du 'khor bar gyur/ 'od spro bsdu sngar bzhin la dga' 'khyil 'od skud du gyur pa'i tshe 'od skud gyen du byung ste sna g.yon nas 'jug zhing thim pa ni 'og spro steng sdud dang*/ 'od skud gsang gnas nyid nas zhugs te thim pa ni 'og spro 'og sdud ces bya'o// de bzhin du 'od kyi g.yas ngos nas ro ma nyi ma'i rlung sems kyi rang bzhin 'od skud lhung ro ma'i mar sna nas zhugs cing sna bug g.yas nas spros shing dga' 'khyil du gyur cing sems can gyi ngag sbyangs/ gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus te slar thim pa sogs kyi g.yas lam sbyang ba'i dmigs pa bzhin no// 'od kor de'i cha thams cad nas spos reng las du ba thon pa ltar dbu ma sgra gcan gyi rlung sems kyi rang bzhin gyen du dbu ma'i yangs pa la bya mkhar brtsegs pa ltar 'khyil zhing 'khor/ phras nas mda' 'phangs pa ltar gyen du phyur gyis byung*/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo'i gsang ba nas zhugs/ sa yig la g.yon skor lan gsum byas pas las kyi mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad mnyes te bde stong du 'ur 'ur 'dug

/sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs par bsam zhing bzla/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i spyi bo nas thon te snying ga /mgrin pa/ spyi bo'i lha la yang de ltar bya/ de nas gyen du song dbu ma nas song ste rdo rje phyed pa'i nang gi bla ma la g.yon skor lan gsum byas pas dam tshig nyams chags dang*// bde stong gis mnyes te byin gyis rlob par bsam/ slar thur du byung ste smin mtshams nas thon te sor bcu drug gi sar dga' 'khyil du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sems sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus te bstim/ dga' 'khyil 'od skud du gyur/ smin mtshams nas zhugs gyen du (153)song nas bla ma'i sku la g.yon skor gsum sogs snga mgo zlog pas mar log /gzhi'i rlung sems dbyer med pa'i sngags phreng sa bon nam 'od kor la bstim zhing thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams te bzla/ de bzhin du gzhan 'dra ba las dga' 'khyil 'od skud tu gyur tshe gsang gnas nas zhugs te thim pas dbu ma'i steng spro 'og sdud dang 'od kor gyi cha thams cad nas spros te 'od skud thur du ltung dbu ma'i mar sna dang gsang gnas nas phyungs te sor bcu drug gi sar dga' 'khyil gdan thabs su 'khor bar gyur/ spro bsdu byas/ 'od skud du gyur tshe gyen du song smin mtshams nas zhugs pa sogs sngar ltar byas pas dbu ma'i 'og spro steng sdud/ gsang gnas nyid nas zhugs na dbu ma'i 'og spro 'og sdud de/ de ltar 'od kor 'od skud dga' 'khyil 'od zer rnams dkar po la brten nas dmigs pa bcu gnyis so// de nas brtan pa cung zad thob pa na de thams cad dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par bsgyur nas dmigs pa bcu gnyis bya'o// brtan pa de bas cher thob nas de thams cad me 'od lta bu dmar zhing tsha la 'bar bar bsgyur bas dmigs pa bcu gnyis bya'o// mtshan ma legs par rnyed cing brtan pa cher thob nas 'od kor gyi 'od skud dga' 'khyil 'od zer de bzhi g.yang 'od du mi byed par sngags phreng gi 'khor lo sngags phreng mda'i shugs lta bu/

sngags phreng tshar bzhi'am gnyis sam mang po las grub pa'i dga' 'khyil sngags kyi yig 'bru bye ma gtor ba lta bu ste bzhi ka'ang ngo bo rlung dang sems tha mi dad pa rnams sngags kha dog dmar ba reg bya tsha ba 'od gsal ba me lta bu sha stag tu byas pa'i dmigs pa bcu gnyis bsgom mo// 'di rnams kyis rlung sems cung zad las su rung ste srog rtsol dbu mar tshud pas bde stong gi myong ba ci rigs skye bar 'gyur ro// bzhi pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ (154)rlung ro legs par bsal/ 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ lte bar dgang dbu mar gzhil/ mi thub na mda' ltar 'phang ba'i sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pas bum can du 'ching*/ sngar gyi gzhi'i sngags phreng 'khor ba la dmigs pa'i bum can bdun/ steng du sngar gong du spros pa'i 'od kor dkar po gsal btab nas de g.yon du drag tu 'khor bzhin pas bum can bdun/ dga' 'khyil drug po rang gnas su g.yon du 'khor bar dmigs nas bum can bdun/ chos 'byung bsnol ma yang g.yon du 'khor zhing de las dga' 'khyil drug mgyogs par 'khor/ de las sngags phreng mgyogs de las 'od kor mgyogs par g.yon du drag tu 'khor bar dmigs te yid kyis bzla nus na legs/ ma nus kyang srog rtsol bcings te sngags phreng sogs bskor ba 'di nyid bzlas pa yin no// de ltar bum can nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bzlas pa tshar gcig ste yang sngar bzhin bya'o// 'di ni 'od kor thabs haṃ yig gi ngo bo sngags phreng gtum mo a thung gi ngo bo dang*/ dga' 'khyil drug thabs dkar cha chos 'byung shes rab dmar cha ste thabs shes gnyis su gnas la 'bar zhu'i rnal 'byor rnam pa gzhan du bsgyur ba ste byang chub kyi sems mi 'pho bar brtan pa 'dzin pa'i yan lag yin no// lnga pa 'gog bzlas chen po ni/ zhal gdams las/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa chos nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa ni nang thugs kyi srog dbang du bsdu ba'o// zhes gsungs pa'i mi sdod pa gsum pa'i bzlas rim dngos te lus snang lha sku snang stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po ngag grags stong sngags kyi sgra dbyangs brag cha lta bu sems rig stong 'od gsal gzhi rtsa dang bral ba chos nyid phyag rgya chen po las g.yo ba med par bzhag ste bzlas pa ste dbang po yang rab yin na bzlas rim 'di kho na la dang po nyid nas 'jug nus pas gzhung zhal gdams kyi dgongs pa dngos (155)yin la/

de ltar mi nus pa'i las dang po pa la bzlas rim snga ma bzhis rim gyis dkri dgos pa yin no// de nas thun gyi mthar lag mchod byas bdud rtsi'i thigs pa phyi rol du 'thor bas bgegs dang ma dag pa tshar bcad nas mkha' 'gro ma'i dra gur du bsam pa ni gnas srung ba'o// bdag nyid la 'thor bas ba spu'i khung bu thams cad mkha' 'gro mas gang bar bsam pa ni bdag srung ba'o// mchod rdzas la gtor bas bdud rtsir bsam pa ni rnal 'byor srung ba ste srung ba rnam pa gsum mo// de nas mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te smin mtshams nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang snying ga nas yi dam chos skyong*/ pus mo g.yon gyi thad nas gzhi bdag dang rigs drug lhar gsal ba la yi ge gsum gyis dbul zhing mthar thigs pa lce thog du myangs pas lus dkyil gyi lha mnyes par byed/ de nas mchod bzhi bstod bzhi'am mchod bstod ci rigs byas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te mdun bskyed yod na de la dbul zhing med na gtor mgron sngags dang 'bar rgyas spyan drangs pa la gtor chog ltar dbul zhing kha kha khā hi sogs dang oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sogs dang*/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*/ sogs kyis mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang*/ mgron bsdu ba'am gshegs/ rjes gtang rag gi mchod bstod cung zad bya/ yig brgya brjod// ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ sgrub pa'i dus su srung 'khor ma gtogs snod bcud skad cig gis bsdus nas bdag nyid dang de 'dus mdo'i hriṃḥdang de yang nā da dang de stong nyid du yal ba la bzhag /skad cig gis sgyu ma lta bu'i sku rten brten pa dang bcas par ldang ngo*// gnyis pa rjes thob kyi bya ba ni/ snod nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang dang bcas par bsam/ bcud kyi sems can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs lngar bsam/ (156)sgra thams cad bai ro tsa nā'i sngags su mos/

rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas bza' btung rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te tshogs 'khor du spyad/ gos zhing chen gyi pags pa dang rgyan rus rgyan/ gdan pad ro nyi ma/ gnas khang chos 'byung gi khang par byas te longs spyad/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud hriṃḥl bsdus te nyal ba'am hriṃḥyal bar byas te nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha' nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis ḍā ma ru dang sngags kyi sgras bslang bar bsam ste ldang zhing slar yang thun gyi bya ba la 'jug pa ste/ 'di ltar dbang rnon gyis thun gnyis/ 'bring gis thun bzhi/ tha mas thun drug tu nyams su blang zhing thun re re'i mtha' 'am yang na phyi ma'i mthar 'og nas 'byung ba'i mdun bskyed bum bskyed kyang ci rigs bya'o// sngags kyi phan yon ni/ 'byung bzhi dbang sdud yi ge bzhi// sde bzhi mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnad// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i sngags su bshad// ces snying po spyi dang khyad par ha ri ni sa ni dngos grub mtha' dag 'byung ba'i sngags yin no// bsnyen tshad ni/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho lngas// tha mal shes pa bsgyur bar nus// zla ba drug tu bzlas pa yis// 'khrul pa'i rtog pa zad par 'gyur// zhes grangs bsnyen dang dus bsnyen gsungs cing*/ 'og nas 'bar ba gsum dang tshugs pa gsum/ 'du ba gsum dang drod gsum thob// shes pa gting nas lhongs pa dang*// lus sems gnyis 'dzin med pa dang*// zhes pas skabs 'dir mtshan ma'i bsnyen par len pa zhal gdams kyi dgongs pa'o// bsnyen tshad de rnams kyang gang zag gi dbang po rim pas zhal gdams las gsungs te ji skad du/ de la dus kyi bsnyen pa ni rab zla ba gsum 'bring lnga tha ma yang bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro// grangs ni rab 'bum tsho lnga 'bring bcu tha ma yang bco (157)lngas 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// mtshan ma la gnyis las/ las dang po pa'i mtshan ma ni zhal gdams dang por/

ma dang sring mo la sogs pa'am bu mo dang bud med chas bzang po dang ldan pa rnams kyis glu len pa dang shon rtse ba dang phyag dang bskor ba byed pa dang bza' btung 'dren pa dang bag phebs pa ni nye ba'i rtags yin no// pho mo 'dres ma byung na cho 'phrul ston pa yin pas ting nge 'dzin sbar ro// pho nyi tshe ba byung na rgyal po'i bar chad yin pas bdud rtsi lnga'i sbyin sreg bya zhing dge sbyor drag tu bya'o// zhes sogs gsungs pas bu mo rgyan can gyis bza' btung ster ba sogs dngos nyams rmi lam du snang na dngos grub nye ba'i rtags yin la/ pho mo 'dres ma byung na rig pa ngar bskyed ste bsgom bzlas la 'bad/ pho nyi tshe ba byung na bdud rtsi lnga'i sbyin sreg dngos sam ma 'byor na yang sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi lngas sbags la sbyin sreg bya/ sprang mor byung na tshogs gtor la 'bad/ yugs sa mor byung na rkyen zlog dang rim gro bya/ mdze mor byung na dam tshig la bshags pa dang tshogs 'khor byed/ phyir bskyed nas 'dug na sgrub pa la brtson 'grus bskyed/ sho re mar byung na gyis gsang ba mi bskrag cing bsgrags pa la bshags pa bya'o// khyad par gyi ltas ni zhal gdams las/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis chos gsung ba dang lung ston pa dang sku mthong ba ḍā ma ru'i sgra grags pa dang chang gi rgyun 'bab pa dang nyin mo mi 'du ba dang mtshan mo mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba dang nang nub zas 'du ba dang lus la bde ba 'bar ba dang ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang sems la rtogs pa 'bar bas rang gzhan gyis lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlob nus pa dang sdug bsngal la sran tshugs pa dang nyams la yan tshugs pa dang gdams ngag la rang byan tshugs (158)pa'ang*/ phyi'i drod lus yod du mi tshor ba dang nang gi drod dbugs rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang*/ gsang ba'i drod rtogs pa la gsal 'grib med pa sogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni khyad par gyi rtags thob pa'o zhes gsungs pa nyid do// gnyis pa mdun bskyed du sgrub pa ni/

zhal gdams kyi dgongs pas/ de dbus hriṃḥlas gyur pa yi// bdud bzhi las rgyal kho mor bskyed// phyogs kyi padma 'dab bzhi la// 'byung bzhi bskyed pa'i sa bon las// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'khor bcas bskyed// ces gong du gsungs pa 'dir blangs nas bdud rtsi dang bighnaṃ gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su e las gdan thabs dang khang thabs kyi chos 'byung gdan pad ro nyi ma'i gdan sngar 'dra ba las nyi ma'i steng du sa bon hrīḥdamar po bsam ste 'phro 'du las gtso mo'i sku rdzogs par bsgom/ 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa so so las 'khor so so bsgom/ gtso mo la don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo dang 'khor bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa bkod/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs te byon legs dang gdan phul nas phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ cung zad bstod nas de rnams kyi sku las zhes sogs kyi dbang bskur nas mthar dam ye dbyer med du bstim mo// de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gsum brgyud kyi bzlas pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi dpral ba nas sku'i 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dpral bar thim/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor gyi dpral ba nas sku'i 'od zer dkar po 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi dpral bar thim pas de rnams kyi sku'i yon tan dang nus mthu dang byin rlabs thams cad sku'i (159)'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas tshur byon mdun bskyed gtso 'khor gyi dpral bar thim pas mdun bskyed gtso 'khor gyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te dpral ba nas 'od dkar po'i rnam pas tshur byon rang gi dpral bar thim pas sku'i byin rlabs thams cad thob ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i bdag nyid nga'o zhes nga rgyal brtan pas sngags bzla'o// de bzhin du mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar pos gsung gsum brgyud/

thugs ka nas sngon pos thugs gsum brgyud/ lte ba nas ser pos yon tan gsum brgyud/ gsang ba nas ljang gus phrin las gsum brgyud kyi bzlas pa bya'o// de nas mchod bzhi bstod bzhi dang tshogs gtor dbul ba sogs bya'o// spyir sgrub tshul gsum las bdag bskyed gtso bor sgrub na bdag bskyed kyi thun re re'i mtha' 'am thun gnyis kyi mtha' 'am yang na thun phyi ma'i mthar mdun bskyed kyi bsgom bzlas byed cing bdag bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du mdun bskyed kyi srung 'khor sogs chud par bsgom la/ mdun bskyed gtso bor sgrub pa'i tshe thun re re'i mgo'am thun dang po'i mgor bdag bskyed kyi bsgom bzlas byed la bdag bskyed kyi srung 'khor sogs kyang mdun bskyed kyi chos 'byung gi nang du chud par byas nas phal cher mdun bskyed nyid sgrub pa'o// cha mnyam du sgrub pa'i tshe gzhal yas khang tha dad pa'am yang na bdag bskyed bsdus nas mdun bskyed du 'pho ba'am thun re bzhin thun stod bdag bskyed thun smad mdun bskyed du sgrub par gsungs la/ spyir dang por bdag bskyed gtso bor sgrub/ grangs bsnyen tsam thems nas cha mnyam dang*/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa sogs la mdun bskyed gtso che bas brtan pa legs par thob nas bdag mdun dang mnyam rjes sogs tha dad med par bskyed rdzogs dbyer med kyis bsgrub bo// gsum pa bum pa sogs sgrub pa ni/ bcu gnyis dbang (160)bskur gyi zhal gdams las gsungs pa ltar bya ste/ bum pa sogs bsang sbyang byas nas/ bum las byung ba'i bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang dang brten pa lha mo lnga bskyed la sa bon rnams dgod/ sindhū ra'i maṇḍal gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po tshon gang pa bsam/ sa bon rnams kyi 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rnam pas steng gi nam mkhar khyab par spyan drangs te sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas hrīḥyig la rgyun mi 'chad par thim zhing hrīḥyig de lci zhing snum pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab ste sandhū ra'i maṇḍal gang phyir lud pas mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi dkyil 'khor gang*/

slar yang lud pas dar dmar gyi dkyil 'khor gang*/ de nas lud pas thod pa gang*/ slar lud pas bum pa gang zhing mthar bum thod kyi rten brten pa yang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam zhing sindhū ra'i maṇḍal gyi steng du gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag la gzungs thag nas bzung la bzlas pa bya'o// bdud rtsi ril bu'am sman du sgrub na 'di kho na gtso bor byed la/ thod pa'i rdzas khol zhing 'phyur ba dang dri bzang po bro ba dang mang du 'phel ba sogs ni dngos grub kyi ltas yin la/ dro ba dang du ba dang 'bar ba gsum ni dngos grub tha ma dang 'bring dang mchog gi mtshan ma'o// spyir las dang po pa dbang po cung zad brtul ba yin na dang por bsnyen pa'i dod du dkyil 'khor ma byas par bdag bskyed rkyang pas bsgrubs nas phyis dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa bya la dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa'i tshe 'di ni mthar sgrub pa 'grol khar bdag 'jug brgya stong sogs blang ngo*// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ bum chu dbang gi dus su dngos grub tu blang*/ sindhū ra'i phyi nang gi maṇḍal mtha' nas bsdus te lte ba dang snying gar byugs/ lhag ma za ma tog tu bcang ngo*// thod pa'i bcud nang mchod yin na dngos (161)grub tu btung zhing sman nam ril bu yin na grub nas phud bla ma la 'bul zhing cha gcig sgrub pa'i grogs la phyin lhag ma ril bu yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam byas pa nang re bzhin myang*/ thod pa sindhū ra dang me long du bcas pa dar dmar dkyil 'khor can des dril zhing 'gro na mchan 'og gam sdod na dben par bcang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'od du zhu bar bsam ste khyams kyi bar phyi nas nang du phyogs nas khang thabs chos 'byung gi steng du dri zhim po'i shing dmar pos chos 'byung gi dbyibs rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs su brtsigs/ lha mtshan sogs la ma gnod par dri zhim pos cung zad bkang*/

dge 'dun gyi tshang mang gi me'am rgyal po'i me sogs kyis sbar te dbus su gzhug /dkyil 'khor gyi lha ye shes kyi me lhar bzhugs pa la sman sna 'bru sna rin po che dri sna dar sna tshogs sogs bdud rtsis sbags pa rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam nas zhal dang phyag tu 'bul bar bsam ste g.yon gyi mtheb srin nam blugs gzar gyis dbul zhing snying po'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags pa brjod/ de bzhin du mar khu dang zhal zas sna tshogs dang btung ba sna tshogs dang tshogs dang gtor ma yang thab tu dbul/ mchod bzhi bstod bzhi bya/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ 'di sgrub pa'i mtha' bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg bya sla zhing tshegs chung ba ste/ gal te spros pa la dga' na bri thab bam bru thab bam rtsigs thabs gang yang rung pa thab zur du byas te 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin sreg rdzas sngags so sos dbul ba yang byar rung ngo*// de nas mchod pa ci 'byor bshams te gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas pa bya/ yig brgya brgya rtsa sogs bzla zhing nongs pa bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed kyi snod bcud rten brten pa dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ste gtso mo la thim/ de sa bon hrīḥyig la thim/ de rang gi hrīḥyig la bsdus te bdag (162)bskyed kyang bsdus nas 'od gsal bar bzhag /slar sgyu ma'i skur langs te dge ba byang chub tu bsngo zhing thal ba dang rdul tshon phyags te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu'am ri bo chen po'i rtser dor/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas te shis pa brjod do// 'di na gzhung nyid las gsang sgrub kyi mtshan du gsungs pa zin bris rnams las nang sgrub ces bshad pa nyams su blang ba'i dngos gzhi yin no// gsum pa gsang ba'i sgrub pa zhal gnyis mar bsgyur ba ni/ spyir zhal gnyis ma'i yig sna mang bar bzhugs kyang 'di ni gzhung zhal gdams kyi yan lag tu rje mar pas mi la la gnang ba'i zhal gdams shog gcig ma zhig yod pa de ltar du bsgom pa ste/

gnas/ dus/ bkod pa/ bshams pa/ sgrub pa dngos rnams gzhan snga ma zhal gcig ma dang khyad med la/ bdag mdun gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon pa'i phag zhal rang mdog can spyan gsum nam mkha' la lta ba/ ze pa mdun phyogs su langs shing rgyab tu zhal lta ba/ mche ba gtsigs cing ngur sgra drag tu sgrog pa re re thon par bsam zhing thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlas rim lnga po sngar ltar bya zhing*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dbu ma'i steng spro dang steng sdud kyi tshe 'od kha dog dmar po dang sngags phreng phag zhal gyi spyan dbu ma'am tshangs bug nas spro ba ni khyad par yin no// mthar hūm̐ gis mkha' 'gro gnad nas bskul/ zhes pa'i zhal gdams de nyid gtso bor bsgom zhing 'di la yang gri gug la brten nas phaṭa yig dang*/ thod khrag la brten nas hrīḥyig brjod pa'i khyad par gsum du phye bas zhal gdams hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa gsum zhes zin bris su gsungs so// mthar skad cig gis rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nga rgyal du 'phos te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung dbu ma'i nang brgyud rdo rje nor bu'i sgo nas thon yum gyi sku'i (163)dbyibs brgyud sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad sngags phreng dang dbyer med du spyan drangs zhal nas zhal du zhugs te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yig bdun 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o// mdor na phyi sgrub mtshams dam lhod ci rigs pas 'bum phrag bzhi/ nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub mtshams dam zhing skye bo'i tshogs dang mi bsre bar brtson 'grus chen pos bcu drug re/ mthar yab kyi nga rgyal du 'phos nas yig bdun 'bum phrag bzhi ste 'bum phrag bzhi bcus grangs bsnyen tshar phyin par 'gyur la/ de thams cad kyi dus su yang snyems thag ji ltar bcad pa ni/

yang med cing tshad bzung med/ rig pa ngar dang bcas pa yis// mi phod brdzi zhing zhen pa ldog /'khri ba btsan thabs dag tu bcad// rang byung ye shes yi ge bzhi// dbyings su shar nas dbyings su rol// gzung ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa'i sems// yang dag don la grub pa med// ces dang*/ zhal gdams drug par/ tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad skye med chos kyi skur rtogs pa'i gding dang ldan pas dpa' rtsal che ba stag lta bu dang*/ gang la'ang nyam nga dang bag tsha med pa seng ge lta bu dang*/ dmigs pa rno zhing rig pa myur la 'khyug pa glog lta bu dang*/ rig pa ngar dang bcas cing rtsal drag pa thog lta bu dang*/ sngags kyi sgra grags shing dpa' ba 'brug lta bu dang*/ gang la'ang gza' gtad med par 'gro ba smyon pa lta bu dang*/ chags zhen dang gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol ba nam mkha' lta bu'i rtogs pa dang ldan pas shes pa kag langs su hur bslangs la brtul zhugs thug phrad du brdeg /nad la gzir gdon la gzir nyon mongs la gzir bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam pa bskyed rim ngo bo chos nyid gzhi rtsa dang bral ba dbyer med du shes pas snang grags rtogs gsum gyi tshogs zil gyis mnan la thad kar bcad par bya'o/// /gsum pa yan lag gi don ni// nad la sman dang (164)'dra bar spyad// ltog na zas dang 'dra bar spyad// 'khyags na gos dang 'dra bar spyad// 'jigs na skyabs dang 'dra bar spyad// gnod sbyin pho mo'i gnod pa la// brtul zhugs thugs phrad lam du khyer// hūm̐ gis mkha' 'gro gnad nas bskul// lam du rten 'brel gang 'phrad bsgrig /zhes don tshan bdun gsungs pa zhal gdams gnyis pa nas brgyad pa'i bar so sos ston no// gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi sgrub pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rlung dang me sogs tshig rkang drug gis bde chen rlung sems gnyis med dang*/ sngar bstan pa/ gzung ba'i yul dang zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyis skye med rlung sems gnyis med gsungs te man ngag las rig par bya'o// gnyis pa grub nas spyod pa bya tshul ni/

nang gi gdeng dang ldan nas ni// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa bya// gcer bu stag gi sham thabs bya// phyag rgya lngas brgyan cang te'u// dril bu sil sil tshangs skud dang*// thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ thogs// dur khrod kun tu rgyu bar bya// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma dag kyang*// rnal 'byor dbang du bsdus la spyad// rlung dang me dang bang ba'i khams// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// bskyil dang ldog dang dgram zhing bstim// dga' bzhi'i ye shes rang ngos bzung*// zhes pa ste dngos grub kyi thod pa mchan khung du bcug ste sandhū ras smin mtshams su thig le byas nas bza' gtad med par grong dang grong khyer sogs su spyad pas rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ste spyod pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa bsrung bya dam tshig la gnyis las dam tshig dngos ni/ rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi// so so'i dam tshig srung tshul ni// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// bla ma la gus spyi bor bkur// sems can (165)rnams la byams pa bsgom// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la spyad// rnam par mi rtog stong nyid bsgom// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen bsham// chags zhen spangs la ri khrod 'grim// padma mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// phyag rgya bsten cing bde ba bsgom// me mchod dbul zhing glu gar bya// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig tu// rgyud la gang skyes shes pa rnams// mi dgag thad kar spyad par bya// zhes gsungs shing nyams na bskang ba'i tshul yang*/ nyams na tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// yi ge brgya pas bshags pa bya// zhes pas tshogs 'khor dang dus bzang gi mchod pa bya'o// mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa dang*// zhes pas lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang*/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa dang*// zhes pas chos sku/

mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa dang*// zhes pas longs sku/ thugs rje 'gag pa med par par 'char/ zhes pas sprul sku ste 'khor lo bzhir sku bzhir mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yin no// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub slob dpon chen po nā ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po nā ro paṇḍi ta'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis puṣpa ha ri'i byang phyogs seng ldeng stug po'i nag gseb tu bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// zhes rje lo tsā bas mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang 'god par mdzad do// bskyed rim lhan cig skyes pa'i lha khrid ji ltar nyams su len tshul 'di ni bskyed rim gsang sgrub kyi rnam bshad zab mo rnam 'byed kyi snying po bsdus te zin bris gsum gyi dgongs pa bzhin dpal gtsug lag phreng bas bshad pa legs par grub bo// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /(166)
